tone: Elegant, luxurious, sensual, minimalist yet visually rich

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (p-8 to p-24) to create a high-end feel.
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical grids for storytelling. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12.
layout.border_radius: Sharp edges. Use rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm for an editorial, premium aesthetic.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-medium hover:bg-[#B3922A] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-zinc-300 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-4 py-2 uppercase text-sm tracking-wider

inputs.style: bg-black/50 border-b border-zinc-800 text-white focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none rounded-none placeholder:text-zinc-600 px-0 py-3 w-full transition-colors

cards.product_card: group relative overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 cursor-pointer
cards.hover_effect: Image scales to 105%. A dark overlay slides in, revealing Scent Notes and Quick Add button via Framer Motion.

navigation.header: Sticky top-0 z-50 w-full backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-white/5
navigation.links: hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-300 hover:text-white

modals.style: backdrop-blur-3xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/95 border border-[#D4AF37]/20 p-8 shadow-2xl rounded-none

animations.page_transition: Framer Motion: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 20 to 0).
animations.hover_states: Smooth scale, opacity shifts. Images scale up duration-700 ease-out.
animations.scroll_effects: Fade-up on scroll for sections to feel cinematic and slow-paced.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images has gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent).
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='nav-shop-link', data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

hero.description: Artistic luxury perfume bottle on textured dark fabric. Perfect for Hero section background with heavy dark overlay at bottom.

products.description: Clear glass bottle on black. Ideal for product grid.
Gold bottle in dark box. Premium product imagery.
Luxurious bottle on rustic wood. Good for 'Best Sellers' or 'Featured'.

lifestyle_floral.description: Dark sensual purple/pink flowers. Great for 'Scent Notes' background or 'Scent Finder Quiz'.
Dark red roses. Good for sensuality mood in 'About' section.

specific_pages.home: Hero section ('Discover Your Signature Scent') -> Product Grid (hover reveals notes) -> Collections (Men/Women/Unisex) -> Sensual Lifestyle image with Scent Finder CTA.
specific_pages.product_detail: Split layout. Left: Sticky large product gallery. Right: Details, Scent Pyramid (Top/Middle/Base notes), Add to Cart, longevity/sillage ratings, accordions.
specific_pages.cart_drawer: Slides from right. Dark background. Shows items, subtotal, 'You May Also Like' cross-sells, Checkout button.
specific_pages.scent_finder: Step-by-step modal quiz. High visual focus with large clickable image-cards for preferences (e.g., 'Floral', 'Woody').
specific_pages.auth: Phone OTP login modal. Glassmorphic, minimal inputs, gold CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Implement pure React JS (.jsx/.js files). DO NOT USE TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
Use Shadcn UI components (configured for JS/Tailwind) but heavily customize them to match the dark luxury aesthetic. Remove the default border-radius.
Always use the 'data-testid' attribute for buttons, forms, nav links, and interactive elements.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex marketing layouts like the Hero and Scent Pyramid. Use Shadcn for the Cart Drawer (Sheet), Modals (Dialog), and Forms.
Ensure the gold accent (#D4AF37) is used elegantly and sparingly.
Do not use Inter font for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit for body.
For product hover effects, reveal the scent notes on hover with a smooth Framer Motion transition.
